mapper.select:
SELECT w.id, w.title, w.work_type AS type, w.is_listed AS listed, w.slug, (SELECT i.resource_url FROM fl_work_image i WHERE i.work_id = w.id AND i.image_kind = 'COVER' AND i.sort_order = 0) AS cover_url
ORDER BY w.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql:
FROM fl_forum_post p JOIN fl_account a ON a.id = p.author_id WHERE p.state IN ('VISIBLE', 'HIDDEN') AND p.screening_thread = 0 AND p.migrated_comment_id IS NULL
AND (INSTR(LOWER(p.title), LOWER(#{q})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(a.display_name), LOWER(#{q})) > 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.title, a.display_name AS author, p.topic, CASE WHEN p.state = 'VISIBLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS listed, TO_CHAR(p.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql:
FROM fl_forum_comment c JOIN fl_forum_post p ON p.id = c.post_id JOIN fl_account a ON a.id = c.author_id LEFT JOIN fl_work w ON w.id = p.work_id WHERE c.state IN ('VISIBLE', 'HIDDEN') AND p.state IN ('VISIBLE', 'HIDDEN') AND p.migrated_comment_id IS NULL
AND p.screening_thread = 10
AND (INSTR(LOWER(c.body), LOWER(#{q})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(p.title), LOWER(#{q})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(w.title), LOWER(#{q})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(a.display_name), LOWER(#{q})) > 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.post_id, p.title AS post_title, CASE WHEN p.screening_thread = 1 THEN 'SCREENING' ELSE 'COMMUNITY' END AS scope, p.work_id, w.title AS work_title, a.display_name AS author, c.body, TO_CHAR(c.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

FROM fl_account a WHERE a.is_deleted = 0
AND (INSTR(LOWER(a.username), LOWER(#{q})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(a.display_name), LOWER(#{q})) > 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.username, a.display_name, a.account_role AS role
ORDER BY a.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
